set_adapter_to_index: set the global adapter to index mapping dictionary for the text generation server
get_adapter_to_index: get the current global adapter to index mapping dictionary from the text generation server
configure_attention_backend: configure the attention backend by setting the ATTENTION environment variable to flashinfer or flashdecoding
configure_prefix_caching: enable or disable prefix caching by setting the PREFIX_CACHING environment variable before importing globals
configure_cuda_graphs: configure CUDA graph batch sizes by setting the CUDA_GRAPHS environment variable to a comma separated list
